spec.title: Shelly Plug
spec.description: Power, energy and health of Shelly plugs scraped by shellyplug-exporter.

spec.title: Live power
spec.description: Combined instantaneous power drawn by the selected plugs.

spec.title: Energy (time range)
spec.description: Energy consumed over the selected time range, from the shellyplug_total counter.

spec.title: Cost (time range)
spec.description: Energy over the selected time range multiplied by the kWh price variable.

spec.title: Energy per hour
spec.description: Energy consumed per plug in each interval (at least one hour), stacked.

spec.title: Energy per day (last 30 days)
spec.description: Daily energy per plug, stacked. Days are aligned on UTC midnight.

spec.title: Voltage
spec.description: Only reported by Gen2 and later plugs.

spec.title: Current
spec.description: Only reported by Gen2 and later plugs.

spec.title: Frequency
spec.description: Only reported by Gen2 and later plugs that measure it; some models omit it.

defaults.noValue: Not reported by the selected plugs

spec.title: Availability
spec.description: Result of the exporter's last scrape of each plug.

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Time since each plug last rebooted.
